bio: Spoil yourself to a luxurious Afternoon Tea at Kingsford Park. Indulge in a selection of delicious sweet and savoury treats at this peaceful country retreat.  Afternoon Tea is served in the restaurant, lounge or outdoor area which is a peaceful oasis of calm providing diners with the ideal environment to unwind while enjoying the great British tradition in picturesque surroundings.  Their menu consists of quintessential features of the British ritual such as sandwiches, scones and cakes. Those feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of prosecco or a refreshing peach Bellini.  Kingsford Park is located in a beautiful parkland setting 2.5 miles away from Colchester town centre
